angle_hi: गुह्यतमम्: सबसे गोपनीय ज्ञान को सील करता है

en.intro: Krishna calls this the most secret teaching. Listen to how he says it changes a human life.
en.notice: The word guhyatamam, the most secret, marks the end of this chapter. It means this is not ordinary advice, but the final key Krishna places in Arjuna's hands.
en.next: Krishna now begins to describe the qualities of the divine and the demonic natures.
en.meaning: O sinless Arjuna, thus this most secret teaching has been spoken by Me. Knowing this, a person becomes wise and has accomplished all that must be done, O descendant of Bharata.

hi.intro: कृष्ण इसे सबसे गोपनीय ज्ञान कहते हैं। सुनिए, वे कैसे कहते हैं कि यह ज्ञान एक इंसान का जीवन पूरा कर देता है।
hi.meaning: हे निष्पाप अर्जुन, इस प्रकार यह अत्यन्त गोपनीय शास्त्र मेरे द्वारा कहा गया है। इसको जानकर मनुष्य ज्ञानवान् तथा प्राप्तप्राप्तव्य और कृतकृत्य हो जाता है।
hi.next: कृष्ण अब दैवीय और आसुरी स्वभाव के गुणों का वर्णन शुरू करते हैं।

en.intro: Krishna calls this the most secret teaching. Listen to how he says it changes a human life.
en.body: O sinless Arjuna, thus this most secret teaching has been spoken by Me. Knowing this, a person becomes wise and has accomplished all that must be done, O descendant of Bharata. The word guhyatamam, the most secret, marks the end of this chapter. It means this is not ordinary advice, but the final key Krishna places in Arjuna's hands. Krishna now begins to describe the qualities of the divine and the demonic natures.

hi.body: हे निष्पाप अर्जुन, इस प्रकार यह अत्यन्त गोपनीय शास्त्र मेरे द्वारा कहा गया है। इसको जानकर मनुष्य ज्ञानवान् तथा प्राप्तप्राप्तव्य और कृतकृत्य हो जाता है। कृष्ण अब दैवीय और आसुरी स्वभाव के गुणों का वर्णन शुरू करते हैं।

issues: meaning_changed: "इसको जानकर मनुष्य ज्ञानवान् तथा प्राप्तप्राप्तव्य और कृतकृत्य हो जाता है।" (The Hindi translation adds the phrase 'प्राप्तप्राप्तव्य' (what is to be obtained/achieved), which is not present in the source Sanskrit, English meaning, or word meanings. The source only states that a person becomes wise (बुद्धिमान्) and accomplished (कृतकृत्यः).)

unsupported: "सुनिए, वे कैसे कहते हैं कि यह ज्ञान एक इंसान का जीवन पूरा कर देता है।" (The intro claims Krishna says this knowledge 'completes a human life' (जीवन पूरा कर देता है). The source only says the person becomes wise and has accomplished all that must be done (कृतकृत्यः). It does not explicitly state that it completes a human life.)

unsupported: "बल्कि वह अंतिम कुंजी है जो कृष्ण अर्जुन को देते हैं।" (The notice describes the secret teaching as 'the final key Krishna places in Arjuna's hands'. This metaphorical detail of a 'key' (कुंजी) being placed in Arjuna's hands is an unsupported invention not found in the source text.)

borrowed: "The word guhyatamam, the most secret, marks the end of this chapter. This means the teaching is not ordinary advice, but the final instruction Krishna gives to Arjuna." (The phrase 'marks the end of this chapter' is not supported by the source text (which only says 'iti guhyatamam' meaning 'thus the most secret'), nor by the provided detail. More critically, the phrase 'but the final instruction Krishna gives to Arjuna' is borrowed from the PREVIOUS verse's content (verse 19), where Krishna describes Arjuna as one who knows Him as the Supreme Self and worships Him. This verse (20) is Krishna's closing statement to Arjuna, not an instruction *to* Arjuna.)
